title: View job roles
i_want: to see a list of open job roles
so_that: I can find a role to apply for
acceptance_criteria: Returns 200 with a list of roles; Each item exposes id, role name, band, capability and closing date; Empty list returns 200 with []

title: View job role information
i_want: to see the full details of a single job role
so_that: I can decide whether to apply
acceptance_criteria: Returns 200 with the detailed shape for an existing id; Returns 404 {message: Job role not found} for a missing id; Returns 400 for a non-numeric id

title: Add a new job role
so_that: new openings appear on the site
acceptance_criteria: Valid body returns 201 with the created role; Invalid body returns 400 with field errors; Unknown band or capability returns 400

title: Update a job role
i_want: to edit an existing job role
acceptance_criteria: Valid update returns 200 with the updated role; Missing id returns 404; Invalid body returns 400 with field errors; Full update, not partial

title: Delete a job role
so_that: closed roles disappear from the site
acceptance_criteria: Existing id returns 204 with an empty body; Missing id returns 404 {message: Job role not found}; Non-numeric id returns 400 before the service is called

title: Linting and formatting
i_want: a single lint and format toolchain
acceptance_criteria: Biome configured; npm run lint and npm run ci:check available; CI fails on lint errors

title: Test setup
acceptance_criteria: Vitest runs with npm test; app /health endpoint covered; CI runs the suite
